children.title: ReBeL
children.description: General self-play RL + search framework that converges to Nash equilibrium in two-player zero-sum games; achieves superhuman HUNL poker (Meta, 2020). Official code.

children.title: DecisionHoldem
children.description: Open-source HUNL AI combining blueprint strategy and real-time safe depth-limited solving. GitHub.

items.title: OpenSpiel
items.description: Google DeepMind's collection of environments and algorithms for RL research in games, with extensive poker support (Kuhn, Leduc, ACPC universal poker interface) and CFR/MCCFR implementations.

items.title: RLCard
items.description: Toolkit for RL in card games; supports Limit/No-Limit Hold'em, Leduc, Blackjack, Mahjong, UNO, and more. Website.

items.title: PyPokerEngine
items.description: Lightweight Python poker engine for AI development with an Emulator class for RL and a browser-based GUI.

items.title: neuron_poker
items.description: Texas Hold'em OpenAI Gym environment with Keras-RL and a C++ equity module (~500x faster than Python).

items.title: PokerRL
items.description: Multi-agent deep RL framework implementing NFSP, Deep CFR, Single Deep CFR, and RPG; supports distributed computing via Ray.

items.title: PokerKit
items.description: Comprehensive Python library supporting Texas Hold'em, Omaha, Stud, Razz, and custom game variants (University of Toronto). Paper.

items.title: deepcfr-texas-no-limit-holdem-6-players
items.description: Deep CFR implementation for 6-player NLHE with progressive training phases (random opponents → self-play → mixed pools), GRU-based opponent modeling, and a PyQt5 GUI. 80+ stars (2024-2025).

items.title: clubs
items.description: Python poker engine with OpenAI Gym interface; supports arbitrary community card game configurations (~714K hand evaluations/sec).

items.title: deuces
items.description: Original pure-Python hand evaluation library, written for the MIT Pokerbots Competition.

items.title: PokerHandEvaluator
items.description: High-performance C/C++ evaluator using a perfect hash algorithm; supports 5-7 card hands and Omaha (PLO4/5/6). Python bindings available.

items.title: treys
items.description: Python 3 hand evaluator using bit arithmetic and lookup tables; evaluates 5/6/7 card hands (~250K evaluations/sec).

items.title: TexasSolver
items.description: Free open-source Texas Hold'em GTO solver with a GUI (Windows/macOS/Linux); performance comparable to PioSOLVER. Website.

items.title: ReBeL
items.description: Meta's official open-source implementation of the ReBeL algorithm for imperfect-information games.

items.title: postflop-solver
items.description: Rust-based postflop GTO solver using Discounted CFR. Also available as a web app and desktop app.

items.title: slumbot2019
items.description: C++ CFR implementations (CFR+, MCCFR, Targeted CFR) by the creator of Slumbot, a multi-year ACPC champion.

A growing number of projects attempt to use general-purpose LLMs for poker. None are competitive with CFR-based solvers, but they serve as research tools and benchmarks for LLM reasoning capabilities.

items.title: HarperJonesGPT/PokerGPT
items.description: PokerStars screen-reading bot using GPT-4 API for decision-making via OCR + prompt engineering. Not fine-tuned — pure API calls. A hobby project, not competitive.

items.title: poker_LLM
items.description: AI-powered Texas Hold'em framework where LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, QWen) act as players. Includes a Vue 3 replay visualization system and AI self-reflection on decisions. Python + Vue 3 (2024-2025).
